items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: That’s a Rick Fay session for Arbors.

ctx.x: That’s my splash cymbal. I only know a couple of other guys who would play it like that. That’s a Rick Fay session for Arbors.
Now on a session like this, I would imagine budget-wise you’re fairly tight with the studio time? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
